entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. You're speaking with Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed and I don't know what to do.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I'm here to help. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the product? What specifically is the issue?

It's the mountain bike shoes I ordered. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats and wearing different socks, but these cycling shoes are just destroying my feet. I have painful blisters after every ride.
Oh, that sounds terrible. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. So to clarify, is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a sizing or preference issue?

I don't think they're broken, they just... they don't work for my feet. I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, and I saved up for these. I really needed this money back if they weren't going to work out.
I completely understand your frustration. Let me see what I can do for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF54912. I'm just hoping I can get a refund.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order was delivered 26 days ago. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Alright, I've checked our policy. Good news – you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. You have no idea how much I appreciate this.

Of course, I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Please repack the shoes in their original box, affix the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out this afternoon. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've made my day!
Glad to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
